data.titulo: Oshitopolwa 5—Okuza mUupika muBabilon sigo Etungululo lyOmankolokuma gaJerusalem
data.contenido:
Pethimbo lyuukwatwa wawo muBabilon Aaisrael oya li ye na omayeleko ogendji keitaalo lyawo. Sadrak, Meshak naAbednego oyu umbilwa meziko lyomulilo gwa hanya, ihe Kalunga okwe ya kutha mo nomwenyo. Konima, sho Babilon sha dhengwa kAamedia nAapersia, Daniel oku umbilwa mekololo lyoonime, ihe Kalunga okwe mu gamene wo mokumutikitha omakana goonime.

Lwahugunina omukwaniilwa gwAapersia Kores okwa mangulula Aaisrael. Yo oya shuna koshilongo shaandjawo oomvula 70 komutse konima sho yo ya li ya falwa kuBabilon oyo oonkwatwa. Shimwe shomiinima yotango mbyoka yo ya longo konima yokugalukila kwawo kuJerusalem osha li okutameka okutunga otempeli yaJehova. Ihe aatondi oyo ya li ya kankameke mbala iilonga yawo. Ano osha li oomvula 22 lwaampono sho yo ya galukile kuJerusalem opo lwahugunina yo ya mane otempeli.

Tashi landula ko otatu ki ilonga kombinga yolweendo lwaEsra okuya kuJerusalem a ka opaleke otempeli. Osha li lwopoomvula 47 konima sho otempeli ya pu. Opo nduno oomvula 13 konima yolweendo lwaEsra, Nehemia okwa kwathele okutungulula omankolokuma omateki gaJerusalem. Oshitopolwa OSHITITANO otashi hokolola oomvula 152 dhondjokonona sigo opethimbo ndyoka..

OTO dhimbulukwa mbela kutya ngoye owu uva nale kombinga yaalumentu mbano aagundjuka yatatu? Eeno, oyo ookuume kaDaniel mboka ya tindile okulya iikulya mbyoka ya li kaayi shi iiwanawa kuyo. Aababilon oye ya luku Sadrak, Meshak naAbednego. Ihe tala ngashingeyi kuyo. Omolwashike yo itayi isizimike ngaashi ayehe yalwe koshiyelekela shika oshinenenene? Natu shi tale.

Oto dhimbulukwa mbela oompango dhi ithanwa Iipango Omulongo mbyoka Jehova a nyola ye mwene? Shotango osha ti: ‘Ngoye ku na okugalikana ookalunga yalwe kakele kangame.’ Aalumentu mbano aagundjuka otaa vulika kompango ndjika, nonando kashi shi oshipu.

Nebukadnesar, omukwaniilwa gwaBabilon, okwi ithana aantu oyendji ya simana okusimaneka oshiyelekela shika ye a ningi. Ye opo a mana okulombwela aantu ayehe ta ti: ‘Uuna tamu uvu omankuma, uuharpa niihikomwa yilwe, ne omu na okwiisizimika nokugalikana oshiyelekela shika shoshingoli. Kehe ngoka iti isizimike noita galikana, ote ku umbilwa mbalambala meziko lya hanya.’

Sho Nebukadnesar ta mono kutya Sadrak, Meshak naAbednego inayi isizimika, ye ota geye noonkondo. Ye ote ya ithana. Ye ote ya pe natango okampito yi isizimike. Ihe aalumentu aagundjuka oyi inekela Jehova. ‘Kalunga ketu ngoka hatu longele, ota vulu oku tu hupitha,’ yo taa ti kuNebukadnesar. ‘Ihe nonando ona kale inee tu hupitha, tse itatu ki isizimikila oshiyelekela shoye shoshingoli.’

Sho ye te shi uvu, natango Nebukadnesar ota geye nokuli noonkondo. Mpeyaka popepi opu na eziko nota ti: ‘Hanyekeni eziko lwiikando iheyali shi vulithe shito!’ Opo nduno aalumentu aanankondonkondo yometanga lye lyaakwiita ote ya mangitha Sadrak, Meshak naAbednego notaye ya umbile meziko. Eziko epyu ngaaka kutya aalumentu aanankondo ya dhipagwe komalaka gomulilo. Ihe ongiini kombinga yaalumentu aagundjuka yatatu mboka yo yu umbile mo?

Omukwaniilwa ota tala meziko lyomulilo nota tila noonkondo. ‘Inatu manga nani aalumentu yatatu notwe ya umbile meziko lyomulilo gwa hanya?’ ye ta pula.

‘Eeno, osho twa ningi,’ aapiya ye taa yamukula.

‘Ihe ngame ondi wete mo aalumentu yane momulilo taa endagula,’ ye ta ti. ‘Yo inaa mangwa, nomulilo itagu ya fike. Nomutine ota monika a fa kalunga.’ Omukwaniilwa ota hedha popepi nomweelo gweziko lyomulilo noti igidha mo: ‘Sadrak! Meshak! Abednego! Zeni mo, one aapiya yaKalunga gwOpo-mbandambanda!’

Sho yo taa zi mo, ayehe otaa vulu okumona kutya yo inaa ningwa sha. Opo nduno omukwaniilwa ota ti: ‘Kalunga kaSadrak, Meshak naAbednego na simanekwe! Ye okwa tumu omuyengeli gwe nokwe ya hupitha molwashoka yo inaya hala yi isizimike nokugalikana kalunga kalwe kakele kakalunga kawo.’

Osho oshiholelwa oshiwanawa kutse shuudhiginini muJehova, hasho mbela? Eksodus 20:3; Daniel 3:1-30.

OSHIKE tashi ningwa mpaka? Aantu otaa ningi oshituthi oshinene. Omukwaniilwa gwaBabilon okwa hiya aayenda ya simana eyuvi. Yo otaa longitha omakopi goshingoli nomakopi goshisiliveli niiyaha mbyoka ya kuthwa motempeli yaJehova muJerusalem. Ihe ombadhilila ominwe dhoshikaha shomulumentu otadhi holoka mombepo notadhi tameke tadhi nyola kekuma. Ayehe oya tila.

Belsasar, omutekulu gwaNebukadnesar, oye ngashingeyi omukwaniilwa. Ye okwi igidha mokule ti ithana aalumentu ye aanongo. ‘Omuntu ngoka ta vulu okulesha enyolo ndika nota lombwele ndje shoka tali ti,’ omukwaniilwa ta ti, ‘ota ka mona omagano ogendji nota ningi omupangeli omutitatu a simanenena muukwaniilwa.’ Ihe hagumwe gwomaalumentu aanongo ta vulu okulesha enyolo kekuma nenge oku li fatulula.

Yina yomukwaniilwa otu uvu ekudhilo note ya koshinyanga oshinene shokulila. ‘Ino kala wa tila ngaaka,’ ye ta ti komu-kwaniilwa. ‘Muukwaniilwa woye omu na omulumentu ngoka e shi ookalunga aayapuki. Sho hokulu Nebukadnesar a li omukwaniilwa, ye okwe mu lenge okutonatela aalumentu ayehe aanongo. Edhina lye oDaniel. Ke mu talithe, note ke ku lombwela shoka tali ti.’

Ano Daniel oti ithanwa mbalambala. Sho ye a tindi okutaamba omagano kehe, Daniel ota tameke ta hokolola molwashike oshikando shimwe Jehova a tidha mo muukwaniilwa hekulu yaBelsasar Nebukadnesar. ‘Ye okwa li e na uuntsa noonkondo,’ Daniel ta ti. ‘Jehova nokwe mu geyele.’

‘Ihe ngoye,’ Daniel ta lombwele Belsasar, ‘ou shi shoka a ningilwa, nangoye natango ou na uuntsa naanaa ngaashi Nebukadnesar. Ngoye owa kuthitha omakopi niiyaha motempeli yaJehova nokunwina mugo. Ngoye owa tanga iikalunga yiiti noyomamanya, noino simaneka Omushiti gwetu Omunene. Osho molwashoka Kalunga a tumu oshikaha okunyola iitya mbika. ‘Osho shoka sha nyolwa ko,’ Daniel ta ti: ‘MENE, MENE, TEKEL na UFARSIN.’

‘MENE otashi ti kutya Kalunga okwa yalula omasiku guukwaniilwa woye nokwe wu hulitha po. TEKEL otashi ti ku-tya ngoye owa yelekwa koshi-yelekitho nowa monika omupu. UFARSIN otashi ti kutya uukwaniilwa woye owa gandjwa po kAamedia nAapersia.’

Manga Daniel ta popi natango, Aamedia nAapersia otaa tameke okuponokela Babilon. Yo otaa kutha ko oshilando notaa dhipaga Belsasar. Enyolo kekuma otali ningi lyoshili uusiku owo tuu mboka! Ihe oshike nee ngashingeyi tashi ka ningilwa Aaisrael? Otatu ke shi mona mo meni lyethimbo efupi, ihe natu tale tango shoka sha ningilwa Daniel. Daniel 5:1-30.

AKUTU! Otashi monika sha fa ongo Daniel e li muudhigu. Ihe oonime itadhi mu ningi sha! Owa tseya kutya omolwashike? Olye a tula Daniel poonime adhihe ndhino? Natu tale.

Omukwaniilwa gwaBabilon ngashingeyi oye omulumentu gwedhina Darius. Ye oku hole Daniel noonkondo, oshoka Daniel omwaanawa ngaaka nomunandunge. Darius okwa lenge Daniel oye a kale elenga ekuluntu muukwaniilwa we. Shika otashi sithitha Daniel efupa kaalumentu yalwe yomuukwaniilwa, notaa ningi ngaashi tashi landula.

Otaa yi kuDarius notaa ti: ‘Omukwaniilwa, tse otwa hala opo u tote po ompango kutya hagumwe e na okugalikana uule womasiku 30 kukalunga kehe nenge komulumentu kehe kakele kangoye, omukwaniilwa. Ngele gumwe ta kala inaa vulika, ye oku na okuumbilwa mekololo lyoonime.’ Darius ke shi kutya omolwashike aalumentu mbaka taa pula pu totwe ompango ndjika. Ihe ye ota dhiladhila kutya olyo edhiladhilo ewanawa, nota nyola ano ompango ndjika. Opo nduno ompango itayi vulu okulundululwa.

Sho Daniel tu uvu kombinga yompango, ye ota yi kegumbo nota galikana, ngaashi naanaa he shi ningi shito. Aalumentu aawinayi oye shi shi kutya Daniel ite ke etha po okugalikana kuJehova. Yo oya nyanyukwa, oshoka otashi monika sha fa ongo ondunge yawo oku ya pepelelitha po kuDaniel tayi longo.

Sho Omukwaniilwa Darius ta mono molwashike aalumentu mbano ya hala ompango ndjika, ye otu uvu nayi noonkondo. Ihe ye ita vulu okulundulula ompango, ano ye oku na okugandja elombwelo kutya Daniel nu umbilwe mekololo lyoonime. Ihe omukwaniilwa ota ti kuDaniel: ‘Ondi inekela kutya Kalunga koye, ngoka ngoye ho longele, ote ke ku hupitha.’ Darius ota nika uuthigwa ngaaka kutya ye uusiku mboka kaa vule okukotha. Ongula ya landula ye ota matukile kekololo lyoonime. Ngoye oto vulu oku mu mona mpeyaka. Ye oti igidha: ‘Daniel, omupiya gwaKalunga omunamwenyo! Kalunga ngoka ho longele a vulu tuu oku ku hupitha koonime?’

‘Kalunga okwa tumu omuyengeli gwe,’ Daniel ta yamukula, ‘nokwa mutikitha omakana goonime opo dhaa ningile ndje uuwinayi.’

Omukwaniilwa okwa nyanyukwa noonkondo. Ye ota ti kutya Daniel na ka talwe mo mekololo. Opo nduno otu umbilitha aalumentu aawinayi koonime mboka taa kambadhala ya pepelelwe po kuDaniel. Nokuli manga inaaya thika pevi, oonime otadhi ya kwata notadhi teyagula omasipa gawo agehe.

Opo nduno Omukwaniilwa Darius ota nyolele aantu ayehe yomuukwaniilwa we: ‘Ngame otandi ti kehe gumwe na simaneke Kalunga kaDaniel. Ye ota longo iikumithalonga iinene. Ye okwa hupitha Daniel kaa like po koonime.’ Daniel 6:1-28, faathanitha OB-1986.

data.titulo: Oshigwana shaKalunga Tashi Thigi po Babilon
data.contenido:
KONYALA oomvula mbali dha piti po okuza sho Babilon a yugwa ko kAamedia nokAapersia. Ngashingeyi tala shoka tashi ningwa po! Eeno, Aaisrael otaa thigi po Babilon. Ongiini yo ya mangululwa mo? Olye e ya pitika ya ye?

OKores, omukwaniilwa gwaPersia. Nale manga Kores inaa valwa, Jehova okwa nyolitha omuprofeti gwe Jesaja kombinga ye: ‘Ngoye oto ka longa naanaa shoka nda hokwa. Omiyelo otadhi ka thigwa inaadhi edhilwa opo ngoye u vule u yuge ko oshilando.’ Kores noye ngoka a li ta wilike pethimbo lyeyugoko lyaBabilon. Aamedia nAapersia oya yi moshilando uusiku ya pitile momiyelo ndhoka dha thigwa inaadhi edhilwa.

Ihe omuprofeti gwaJehova Jesaja okwa ti wo kutya Kores ota ka gandja elombwelo kutya Jerusalem notempeli yasho yi tungululwe. Kores mbela elombwelo ndika okwe li gandja ngaa? Eeno, okwe li gandja. Osho shika Kores ta lombwele Aaisrael: ‘Indeni ngashingeyi kuJerusalem nomu tunge otempeli yaJehova Kalunga keni.’ Nosho naanaa shoka Aaisrael mbaka ye li mondjila oku ka ninga.

Aaisrael ayehe mboka ye li muBabilon inaa vula okukutha olweendo olule okushuna kuJerusalem. Olwo olweendo oluleeleka, konyala lwookilometa 800, noyendji oya kulupa noonkondo nenge taye ehama unene nokuya molweendo olule ngawo. Nopu na omatompelo gamwe molwashike yamwe itaaya yi. Ihe Kores ota ti kwaamboka itaaya yi: ‘Gandjeni oshisiliveli noshingoli nomagano galwe kaantu mboka taa shuna oku ka tungulula Jerusalem notempeli yasho.’

Ano Aaisrael mbaka ye li mondjila okushuna kuJerusalem otaa pewa omagano ogendji. Kores ota gandja wo kuyo iiyaha nomakopi ngoka Omukwaniilwa Nebukadnesar a kuthile motempeli yaJehova sho ye a hanagula po Jerusalem. Aantu oye na iinima oyindji okuhumbata pokushuna kwawo.

Konima yolweendo lwoomwedhi ne lwaampono, Aaisrael otaa thiki muJerusalem pethimbo lela. Osha li naanaa oomvula 70 okuza ethimbo ndyoka oshilando sha hanagulwa po, noshilongo osha li sha thigwa po shaa na aantu. Nonando ngashingeyi Aaisrael oya galukila koshilongo shawo, opu na omathimbo omadhigu ge li komeho, ngaashi tatu ke shi mona ngashingeyi. Jesaja 44:28; 45:1-4; Esra 1:1-11.

AANTU omayuvi ogendji oya kutha olweendo olule okuza muBabilon okuya kuJerusalem. Ihe sho yo taa thiki hono, Jerusalem osho ondumba onene yiikulukuma. Kamu na omuntu. Aaisrael oye na okutungulula ayihe okuza ketameko.

Shimwe shomiinima mbyoka yo taa tungu tango, osho oaltari. Oyo ehala mpoka yo taa vulu okweetela Jehova omayambo giinamwenyo nenge omagano. Konima yoomwedhi dhimwe Aaisrael otaa tameke okutunga otempeli. Ihe aatondi yomiilongo yopopepi mpoka inaa hala Aaisrael ye yi tunge. Yo otaa kambadhala ano oku ya mbandameka opo yo ye ethe oku yi tunga. Lwahugunina aatondi mbaka otaa ningitha omukwaniilwa gwaPersia a ninge po ompango ndjoka tayi indike iilonga yetungo.

Oomvula otadhi piti po. Ngashingeyi odho oomvula 17 okuza sho Aaisrael ya galukile muBabilon. Jehova ota tumu aaprofeti ye Haggai naSakaria okulombwela oshigwana shi tameke ishewe okutunga. Oshigwana oshi inekela mekwatho lyaKalunga, osho notashi vulika kaaprofeti. Sho otashi tameke ishewe okutunga, nokuli nando ompango oyi tye kutya kashi na oku shi ninga.

Omukwanepangelo Omupersia gwedhina Tattenai ote ya ano okupula Aaisrael uuthemba uni po yo ye na okutunga otempeli. Aaisrael otaa ti kuye kutya sho yo ya li muBabilon, Omukwaniilwa Kores okwa ti kuyo: ‘Indeni ngashingeyi kuJerusalem nomu tunge otempeli yaJehova, Kalunga keni.’

Tattenai ota tumine ombilive kuBabilon nota pula ngele Kores, ngoka a si, oye e shi ti shili. Mbalambala ota mono ombilive ya za komukwaniilwa omupe gwaPersia. Otayi ti kutya Kores okwe shi popya shili. Ano omukwaniilwa ota nyola: ‘Etheni Aaisrael ya tunge otempeli yaKalunga kawo. Notandi mu lombwele mu ya kwathe.’ Otempeli oya pu konyala meni lyoomvula ne, Aaisrael noya nyanyukwa noonkondo.

Oomvula odhindji natango otadhi piti po. Ngashingeyi konyala odho oomvula 48 okuza sho otempeli ya pu. Aantu muJerusalem oyo aathigona, noshilando notempeli yaKalunga itayi monika ombwanawa unene. MuBabilon Omwiisrael Esra otu uvu kutya otempeli yaKalunga oyi na okwoopalekululwa. Owa tseya kutya oshike ye ta ningi po?

Esra ota yi kuArtahsasta, omukwaniilwa gwaPersia, nomukwaniilwa nguka omwaanawa ota gandja omagano ogendji kuEsra a ye nago kuJerusalem. Esra ota pula Aaisrael yomuBabilon ye mu kwathe okuhumbata omagano ngaka ye ga fale kuJerusalem. Aantu 6 000 lwaampono otaa ti kutya yo otaa ka ya. Yo oye na ondumba yoshisiliveli noshingoli niinima yilwe yondilo mbyoka yo ye na okuhumbata.

Esra okwa nika uuthigwa, oshoka mondjila omu na aalumentu aawinayi. Aalumentu mbaka sikulimwe otaye ke ya kutha oshisiliveli noshingoli notaye ya dhipaga. Ano Esra oti ithana aantu ya gongale, ngaashi to vulu oku shi mona mefano. Opo nduno otaa galikana kuJehova e ya gamene molweendo lwawo olule okushuna kuJerusalem.

Jehova ote ya gamene. Nokonima yolweendo lwoomwedhi ne yo otaa thiki nawa muJerusalem. Otashi holola kutya Jehova ota vulu okugamena mboka yi inekela mekwatho lye, hasho mbela? Esra ontopolwa 2 sigo 8.

KONIMA yoomvula dhimwe manga Esra inaa ya kuJerusalem, Mordokai naEster oya li Aaisrael ya simanenena muukwaniilwa waPersia. Ester oye omukwaniilwakiintu, nantsezi ye Mordokai okwa simana kwaayehe kakele komukwaniilwa. Natu tale nkene sha ningwa.

Aakuluntu yaEster oya si manga ye a li omushona noonkondo, ano Mordokai oye e mu tekula. Ahasveros, omukwaniilwa gwaPersia, oku na uuwa moshilando shaSusa, Mordokai noye gumwe gwomaapiya ye. Esiku limwe Vasti, omukiintu gwomukaniilwa, ina vulika komukwaniilwa, oye nota hogolola ano omukiintu gumwe omupe okukala oye omukwaniilwakiintu gwe. Owa tseya kutya ye ota hogolola lye? Eeno, omugundjuka omwaanawa Ester. Ou wete omulumentu nguno omunuuntsa ngoka aantu taye mu isizimikile? Oye Haman. Oye omulumentu a simana noonkondo muPersia. Haman okwa hala Mordokai, ngoka ngoye to vulu okumona a kuutumba mpeyaka, naye wo e mu isizimikile. Ihe Mordokai ota tindi. Ye ota dhiladhila kutya osha puka okwiisizimikila omulumentu omwiinayi ngawo. Otashi geyitha Haman noonkondo. Ano ye ota ningi tashi landula.

Haman ota hokololele omukwaniilwa iifundja kombinga yAaisrael. ‘Yo oyo aantu aawinayi mboka itaa vulika koompango dhoye,’ ye ta ti. ‘Yo oye na okudhipagwa.’ Ahasveros ke shi shi kutya omukiintu gwe Ester Omwiisrael. Ano ye ota pulakene kuHaman nota totitha po ompango kutya Aaisrael ayehe esiku lyontumba oye na okudhipagwa.

Sho Mordokai tu uvu kombinga yompango ndjika, ye ota nika uuthigwa noonkondo. Ye ota tumine etumwalaka kuEster: ‘Ngoye ou na okuhokololela omukwaniilwa nou mu galikane e tu hupithe.’ MuPersia otashi tsu ondumbo nompango okutalela po omukwaniilwa ngele ngoye ino hiywa. Ihe Ester ota yi inaa hiywa. Omukwaniilwa ota gandja onkwaniilwandhimbo ye yoshingoli kuye, shoka tashi ti kutya ye ke na okudhipagwa. Ester ota hiya omukwaniilwa naHaman koshitelekela oshinene. Hoka omukwaniilwa ota pula Ester esilohenda lini po ta vulu oku mu ningila. Ester ota ti kuye kutya ye ote ke shi mu lombwela ngele ye naHaman esiku tali landula taye ya ishewe koshitelekela.

Poshitelekela shoka Ester ota lombwele omukwaniilwa: ‘Ngame noshigwana shandje otatu ka dhipagwa.’ Omukwaniilwa ota geye. ‘Olye ta wapa okuninga oshinima sha tya ngawo?’ ye ta pula.

‘Omulumentu omutondi oye Haman nguno omwiinayi!’ Ester ta ti. Ngashingeyi omukwaniilwa okwa geya shili. Ye ota ti kutya Haman oku na okudhipagwa. Opo nduno omukwaniilwa ota tula Mordokai pondondo ya simana kakele ke mwene. Mordokai ota si nduno oshimpwiyu opo pu ningwe ompango ompe ndjoka tayi pitika Aaisrael ya kondjele oomwenyo dhawo mesiku ndyoka yo ye na okudhipagwa. Molwashoka Mordokai ngashingeyi omulumentu a simana ngawo, aantu oyendji otaa kwathele Aaisrael, notaa hupithwa kaatondi yawo. Embombimbeli Ester.

TALA owala nkene mpaka tapu longwa. Aaisrael oyi ipyakidhila okutunga omankolokuma gaJerusalem. Sho Omukwaniilwa Nebukadnesar a hanagula po Jerusalem oomvula 152 dha piti po, ye okwa teyagula po omankolokuma nokwa fike po omiyelo dhoshilando. Aaisrael inaa tungulula omankolokuma mbala sho yo ya galuka okuza muBabilon.

Ngoye oto dhiladhila kutya aantu oya li ye shi uvitile ngiini okukala oomvula adhihe ndhino yaa na omankolokuma ga kundukidha oshilando shawo? Yo kaya li ye uvite ya gamenwa. Aatondi yawo oya li taa vulu oku ya ponokela nuupu. Ihe lwahugunina omulumentu nguka Nehemia ota kwatha oshigwana ngashingeyi okutungulula omankolokuma. Owa tseya kutya Nehemia oye lye?

Nehemia oye Omwiisrael ngoka ta zi koshilando shaSusa hoka kwa kala Mordokai naEster. Nehemia okwa longo muuwa womukwaniilwa, ano ye okwa li ngiika kuume omwaanawa gwaMordokai nOmukwaniilwakiintu Ester. Ihe Ombimbeli itayi ti kutya Nehemia okwa longelele omulumentu gwaEster, Omukwaniilwa Ahasveros. Ye okwa longelele Omukwaniilwa Artahsasta, omukwaniilwa ngoka a landula ko.

Dhimbulukwa kutya Artahsasta oye omukwaniilwa omwaanawa ngoka a gandja iimaliwa ayihe mbiyaka kuEsra oku yi fala kuJerusalem yi ka opalekithe otempeli yaJehova. Ihe Esra ye ina tungulula omankolokuma omatekipo goshilando. Natu tale nkene she ende opo Nehemia a longe iilonga mbika.

Oomvula 13 odha piti po okuza sho Artahsasta a gandja iimaliwa kuEsra okwoopaleka otempeli. Ngashingeyi Nehemia oye omupindi omukuluntu gwOmukwaniilwa Artahsasta. Otashi ti kutya ye oha pindi omaviinu gomukwaniilwa noha si oshimpwiyu kutya gumwe kaa kambadhale a tulile mo omukwaniilwa uuzigo. Oyo iilonga ya simana noonkondo.

Esiku limwe omumwayina gwaNehemia, Hanani, naalumentu yalwe yokoshilongo shaIsrael otaye ya okutalela po Nehemia. Yo otaye mu hokololele kombinga yomaupyakadhi gAaisrael, nonkene omankolokuma gaJerusalem ga tekauka natango. Otashi yematitha Nehemia noonkondo, nota galikana kuJehova molwasho.

Esiku limwe omukwaniilwa ota ndhindhilike kutya Nehemia okwa yemata, nota pula: ‘Omolwashike to monika wa yemata ngawo?’ Nehemia ota ti kuye kutya osho molwashoka Jerusalem shi li monkalo ombwinayi ngawo nomankolokuma ga tekauka. ‘Owa hala ndi ku ningile shike?’ omukwaniilwa ta pula.

‘Pitika ndje ndi ye kuJerusalem,’ Nehemia ta ti, ‘opo ngame ndi vule okutungulula omankolokuma.’ Omukwaniilwa Artahsasta omwaanawa noonkondo. Ye ota ti kutya Nehemia ota vulu okuya, note mu kwathele okumona iipilangi yokutungitha. Konima yokuthika kwaNehemia muJerusalem, ye ota hokololele oshigwana kombinga yomadhiladhilo ge. Yo oya panda ondunge ndjika, notaa ti: ‘Natu tamekeni okutunga.’ Sho aatondi yAaisrael taa mono enkolokuma tali yi pombanda, yo otaa ti: ‘Tse otatu ke ya dhipaga nokukankameka iilonga yawo yetungo.’ Ihe Nehemia otu uvu kombinga yasho, nota pe aalongi omagongamwele nomagonga. Nota ti: ‘Inamu tila aatondi yetu. Kondjeleni aamwanyoko, aana yeni, aakiintu yeni nomagumbo geni.’

Aantu omapenda noonkondo. Yo oya longekidha aluhe iikondjitho yawo omutenya nuusiku notaa tsikile nokutunga. Ano omankolokuma oga pu owala meni lyomasiku 52. Ngashingeyi aantu otaa vulu okuuva ya gamenwa meni lyoshilando. Nehemia naEsra otaa longo oshigwana oompango dhaKalunga, naantu oyu uvite elago.

Ihe iinima kayi li natango ngaashi sha li manga Aaisrael ya li inaaya falwa kuBabilon oyo oonkwatwa. Omukwaniilwa gwaPersia oye ta pangele oshigwana noshi na oku mu longela. Ihe Jehova oku uvaneke kutya ye ota ka tuma omukwaniilwa omupe, nonokutya omukwaniilwa nguka ote ke etela oshigwana ombili. Omukwaniilwa nguno oye lye? Ongiini ye te ke eta ombili kombanda yevi? Manga aantu inaaya tseya oshindji kombinga yaashika, otapu piti konyala oomvula 450. Opo nduno okahanona ka simana kwaa na we oka valwa. Ihe olyo ehokololo lilwe. Nehemia ontopolwa 1 sigo 6.
